Where the turns go

Every turn of every scored episode, sorted into one outcome, with a real example of each kind underneath.

Read the shares, not the delivery rate. On the occasions the courier picks a street that is actually on offer it picks the route's own next street about two thirds of the time — the shortfall is not in choosing, it is in the turns spent on streets that are not there and on repeating itself.
